copy_relationship: Copy the world-space relationship between selected objects.
Select followers first and the driver last.
paste_relationship: Restore the copied relationship at the current frame, or at existing relationship-object keys when a timeline range is selected.
paste_range: Restore the copied relationship at existing relationship-object keys in the selected timeline range, or the playback range when no range is selected.
auto_link: Keep the copied followers attached to the driver while editing or changing frames.
